title: Protocol Symposium 2026
short_description: The third annual Protocol Symposium, bringing together researchers, practitioners, and institutions working across the challenges and opportunities of protocolization. Submissions open; deadline June 14.

title: Bridge Atlas at Devconnect 2025
short_description: A day-long gathering at Devconnect Buenos Aires convened by the Summer of Protocols team, drawing on three years of protocol research to explore how protocols can serve as bridges across disciplines, communities, and institutions.

title: Protocol Symposium 2025
short_description: The second annual Protocol Symposium — a week-long capstone event organized around the theme Accelerating Order, comprising the Foundations Workshop (Sep 12–14, a research sprint toward a formal theory of protocols) and Protocol School (Sep 15–19, twelve modules delivered by eleven university teaching fellows).

title: Edge Esmeralda Workshop 2025
short_description: A Protocol Institute workshop held during Edge City's month-long popup village in Healdsburg, continuing ongoing collaboration on protocol design and experimental community infrastructure.

title: Khlongs and Subaks Workshop 2025
short_description: A workshop at CMKL University in Bangkok examining traditional water management protocols — Thai canal systems (khlongs) and Balinese communal irrigation systems (subaks) — as models for understanding how premodern societies designed complex coordination infrastructure.

title: Edge Lanna Workshop 2024
short_description: A Summer of Protocols workshop held during Edge City Lanna, examining protocol design in the context of experimental community governance and distributed coordination across cultural and institutional boundaries.

title: Protocol Symposium 2024
short_description: The inaugural Protocol Symposium — a week-long online capstone event for Summer of Protocols 2024, bringing together researchers, practitioners, and teaching fellows from across the SoP24 community.

title: Edge Esmeralda Workshop 2024
short_description: A Summer of Protocols workshop held during Edge Esmeralda 2024, Edge City's month-long popup village in California wine country. Sessions explored futures and worldbuilding through the lens of protocol design.

title: Datus and Nusas Workshop 2024
short_description: A Summer of Protocols workshop in Singapore examining traditional governance and coordination protocols drawn from Southeast Asian and Maritime Southeast Asian societies, including the datu leadership traditions of the Philippines and Malay world.

title: Researcher Retreat 2023
short_description: The inaugural Summer of Protocols researcher retreat at St. Edward State Park, Seattle — an in-person gathering for the SoP23 cohort to establish the program's research agenda and build the founding community.
